Remark
[Classical and generalized solutions] 1. ch8:8.1–8.4\group ch08-generalized-solutions Classical solutions satisfy these generalized identities whenever the integrals are defined. Conversely, a $C^2$ generalized solution is classical when the coefficients needed to expand the divergence terms are sufficiently regular.
